# inkscape-mcp: Rust STDIO server

Run ./setup.sh then ./run-mcp.sh. See README.md and docs/agent-usage-guide.md.
Native Rust runtime and build tools; ready packages contain no Python runtime.

## Tools
- add_linear_gradient: Add a `<linearGradient>` to the document `<defs>` (created if absent).
- add_radial_gradient: Add a `<radialGradient>` to the document `<defs>` (created if absent).
- apply_edits: Apply an ordered list of typed DOM edits to a document as ONE atomic, reversible operation.
- apply_palette: Apply many `from -> to` colour replacements in a single reversible operation.
- boolean_difference: Subtract the top path(s) from the bottom one via the Inkscape engine (``path-difference``).
- boolean_union: Union two or more paths into one via the Inkscape engine (``path-union``).
- break_apart: Break a compound path into its subpaths via the Inkscape engine (``path-break-apart``).
- capture_frame: Capture the next numbered PNG screenshot in a per-run frame series.
- check_live_support: Report which live transports are available on this host (read-only; no connection).
- cleanup_paths: Reduce path nodes via the Inkscape engine (``path-simplify``) — an explicit alias of
- combine_paths: Combine paths into a single multi-subpath path via the Inkscape engine (``path-combine``).
- compare_region: Render the same fixed region from a pre-edit snapshot and the current working copy.
- compose_grid: Lay out N DIFFERENT assets in a grid (contact / spec sheet) in ONE reversible call.
- create_circle: Create a `<circle>` centred at `(cx, cy)` with radius `r` (> 0).
- create_document: Create a blank, tracked working-copy document from scratch — NO source file required.
- create_ellipse: Create an `<ellipse>` centred at `(cx, cy)` with radii `rx` / `ry` (> 0).
- create_group: Create an empty `<g>` group inside `parent_id` (must exist) or the document default parent.
- create_icon_set: Export a multi-size square PNG icon set from the source document.
- create_line: Create a `<line>` from `(x1, y1)` to `(x2, y2)`.
- create_path: Create a `<path>` with the validated `d` data string.
- create_polygon: Create a closed `<polygon>` from `points` (≥ 1 `(x, y)` pairs).
- create_polyline: Create an open `<polyline>` from `points` (≥ 1 `(x, y)` pairs).
- create_rect: Create a `<rect>` at `(x, y)` sized `width` / `height` (> 0), with optional corner radii.
- create_snapshot: Snapshot the current working copy of a document and index it.
- create_text: Create a `<text>` element anchored at `(x, y)` holding `text`.
- create_use: Create a `<use href="#href_id">` referencing an existing same-document object.
- delete_object: Delete objects by id from a document in ONE reversible, snapshot-backed operation.
- diagnose_runtime: Probe the local Inkscape + Python runtime fresh and return the capability matrix.
- discover_extensions: List the server-side allowlisted Inkscape extensions + probe notes (read-only, diagnostic).
- duplicate_object: Duplicate an object or group in place, inserting the clone right after the original.
- export_batch: Run a bounded batch of typed export specs in one call (dry-run by default).
- export_document: Export the whole document to PNG, PDF, or SVG.
- export_object: Export a single object (by id) to PNG, PDF, or SVG.
- export_print_profile: Export a print-oriented PDF (vector, page area) of the whole document.
- export_set: Batch-export a SET of documents in one call: per-doc results + aggregate + verdict.
- export_web_profile: Export a web-oriented asset set: a responsive PNG set plus one plain SVG.
- find_objects: Find addressable object ids in a tracked document by tag / paint / text / id-prefix / bbox.
- fit_to_content: Fit the document's root ``viewBox`` to its CONTENT bounding box.
- get_workspace_info: Discover configured server workspace roots and portable artifact access.
- group_objects: Wrap existing objects (`object_ids`, ≥ 1, all must exist) in a NEW `<g>`.
- how_do_i: Map a natural-language goal to the concrete inkscape-mcp tool(s) that achieve it.
- insert_svg_fragment: Insert an agent-composed SVG fragment under a parent (`parent_id`) or the document root.
- inspect_document: Inspect a loaded document: tree, layers, styles, fonts, external assets.
- list_actions: Discover the host's actual Inkscape Action surface (probe-driven, version-aware).
- list_capabilities: Return the cached runtime capability matrix (probed once, then reused).
- list_frames: List the frames of a `capture_frame` series, ordered by index.
- list_snapshots: List a document's snapshots in order, with metadata.
- live_apply_to_selection: Apply a validated style and/or simple transform to the current live selection.
- live_arm_socket: Auto-arm the extension-socket helper so a programmatic launch gets the FULL live surface.
- live_change_package: Plan and preview 1..16 typed style/transform/text edits on a fixed current selection. dry_run=true is read-only and needs no approval; it returns before/after PNG paths and document/selection/fingerprint guards. Review them and resubmit the same edits with dry_run=false, all guards and client-confirmed approval_token. Only the guarded managed native helper applies, through one candidate publication and a Live Operation Record. Failed plans and net no-ops do not mutate or add records. No structural edits/insertion/actions. Native GUI Undo/Redo passed only for a scoped synthetic style/text package; do not promise live atomicity. Inspect after uncertainty before retry; recover confirmed changes through native Undo. Risk class: high when applying, low when planning.
- live_connect: Connect to a running Inkscape over the best-ranked available transport (enables live).
- live_diff_view: Produce a FOCUSED, annotated before/after visual diff of a live operation.
- live_disconnect: Disconnect the current live session (the X1 disable switch). Idempotent.
- live_edit_selection: Duplicate, delete, group, ungroup or reorder selected objects in managed macOS Inkscape.
- live_export_selection: Export just the current live selection to a PNG under the live artifacts dir.
- live_find_objects: Find visible live objects by layer, label, text, tag or id prefix, with engine bounds.
- live_get_active_document: Identify the document open in the connected live instance (read-only).
- live_get_scene: Capture one live frame as a PNG PLUS a structured, machine-readable `LiveScene`.
- live_get_selection: Read the current selection in the live instance as object ids (read-only).
- live_insert_svg: Insert an SVG fragment into the running document.
- live_inspect_objects: Inspect bounded static computed paint and local gradient/mask/clip/pattern/clone relationships from one live snapshot. Supply 1..100 IDs. Simple type/ID/class/universal CSS, importance, defaults and inheritance are supported; unsupported CSS/dynamic/context paint yields explicit unknowns. Clone shadow-tree paint and resource coverage require rendered review. No renderer, external fetch, selection change or Undo. Risk class: low.
- live_inspect_selection: Inspect the selected objects in the live instance (semantic, by id; read-only).
- live_install_helper: Install the shipped extension-socket helper into the Inkscape user extensions dir.
- live_launch: Explicitly launch or reuse the managed Inkscape window on macOS.
- live_list_documents: List open managed macOS drawing windows with opaque window and document IDs.
- live_preview_object: Render one found live object in isolation without changing the GUI selection.
- live_render_view: Rasterize the live canvas to a PNG in the live artifacts dir (visual feedback).
- live_select_document: Activate and bind an open drawing window as the document for this task.
- live_session_step: Run ONE perceive→decide→act→observe iteration of the live-view loop.
- live_set_selected_text: Replace the selected text object's content in the running document.
- live_set_viewport: Control the live canvas viewport: zoom / pan / fit-to-selection / fit-to-page.
- live_status: Report live-session state: enabled, connected, active transport, available transports.
- live_sync_to_workspace: Save the live document's current state into the workspace as a NEW tracked document.
- live_wait_for_change: Block until the live state changes, or the bounded timeout elapses (read-only).
- move_object: Translate an object/group by ``(dx, dy)`` in its parent coordinate space.
- normalize_viewbox: Normalize or repair the document's root ``viewBox``.
- open_document: Open an SVG into a tracked workspace document and return its id + summary.
- optimize_set: Web-optimize a SET of documents in one call: per-doc results + aggregate + verdict.
- place_document: Place an existing document or object INTO another document at `(x, y)` with `scale`.
- prune_snapshots: Apply the snapshot + live-frame retention policy, pruning superseded server state.
- quality_report: Build a machine-readable quality report for a document: validation findings plus metrics.
- quality_report_set: Quality-report a SET of documents in one call: per-doc reports + aggregate + verdict.
- reload_document: Refresh a working copy FROM ITS SOURCE under the SAME `doc_id`, discarding working edits.
- rename_object: Change an object's `id` and/or its `inkscape:label`.
- render_preview: Render a PNG preview of the whole document into the artifacts dir.
- reparent_object: Move an object (`object_id`) under a new parent (`new_parent_id`); both must exist.
- repeat_objects: Place editable instances along a polyline (two points = line) or in a rectangle.
- replace_color: Replace one colour with another across the document (or within `scope_ids` subtrees).
- replace_svg_fragment: Replace one selected SVG subtree atomically, retaining its container ID and qualified tag.
- replace_text: Replace the text content of a text element (`<text>` / `<tspan>` / flow text).
- resize_canvas: Set the document canvas ``width`` / ``height`` to validated CSS lengths.
- restore_snapshot: Revert a document's working copy to a chosen snapshot.
- rotate_object: Rotate an object/group by ``degrees`` about a point.
- run_action_chain: Execute a validated Action chain over a document's working copy (HIGH risk, approval-gated).
- run_raw_action: Run ONE raw, allowlisted Inkscape Action over a document (advanced mode; OFF by default).
- save_document_as: Save a document's current working-copy state to a NEW file in the workspace.
- scale_object: Scale an object/group by factor ``sx`` (and ``sy``, defaulting to ``sx`` for uniform).
- set_document_svg: REPLACE the whole working copy with an agent-composed SVG string (root must be `<svg>`).
- set_fill: Set the fill colour (and optional fill opacity) of one or more objects.
- set_font: Set font-family / font-size / font-weight on one or more text objects.
- set_group_mode: Convert the same g between ordinary group and layer; preserve ID and all other attributes.
- set_opacity: Set the element-level opacity of one or more objects.
- set_stroke: Set the stroke colour, width, and/or opacity of one or more objects.
- simplify_path: Simplify the given path(s) via the Inkscape engine (``path-simplify``).
- stat_artifact: Return the on-disk byte size + sha256 digest of one sandboxed artifact.
- stat_artifacts: Stat a SET of sandboxed artifacts: per-file size + sha256 plus an aggregate byte total.
- stroke_to_path: Convert each object's stroke into a filled path via the Inkscape engine.
- svg_web_optimize: Web-optimize an SVG: strip editor metadata, drop dead structure, reduce coordinate precision.
- tile: Lay out a ``rows`` x ``cols`` grid of an object in ONE reversible operation.
- transform_objects: Apply ONE typed op to EVERY object a selector matches — one atomic, reversible operation.
- validate_action_chain: Dry-run-validate an ordered Action chain and return its resolved plan (NO mutation).
- validate_document: Validate a loaded document and return structured, machine-readable findings.

## Resource templates
- document_summary: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/summary
- document_tree: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/tree
- document_layers: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/layers
- document_objects: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/objects
- document_styles: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/styles
- document_fonts: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/fonts
- document_assets: inkscape://document/{doc_id}/assets
- artifact: inkscape://artifact/{root_key}/{token}
